local_motion.limits: Bounded isolated-layer pixel change, with text/shadows excluded and ancestors frozen; geometry is conservative. Causal action, final visibility/occlusion, semantic captions and sound still require playback review

portrait.limits: Bounded authored-key/visibility and 0.25s paint sampling, not every encoded frame. Occlusion intervals join consecutive occluded eligible samples; their start/end are sample times, not verified continuous or exact occlusion boundaries. Actual isolated ink fit and at least one nonzero full-composition contribution per eligible member do not prove readable partial occlusion, causal contact, natural acting or aesthetic/sample equivalence. Review the complete final video at its intended phone size and actual sound.
